summary: Closes the production API composition HIGH finding by forcing all non-health routes through edge validation, authentication, canonical tenant resolution and authorization with no public-route bypass flag.

impacts.evidence: Private handlers receive a validated organization/workspace scope only after the authenticated principal is resolved through TenantResolver and authorized.
Raw bearer credentials and unbounded IdP claims are not copied to request context; only a minimized principal and canonical scope are propagated.
The existing public health operation is unchanged; unmounted feature handlers remain unavailable rather than being exposed without security composition.

Trusted-proxy validation, bounded rate limiting, origin/CSRF policy and headers wrap routing; private route startup requires Authenticator, TenantResolver and Authorizer and there is no custom-public flag.
Admin-only route descriptors add validated client-IP allowlisting on top of application authorization.
The composition preserves minimized identity/scope/client-IP context for downstream audit without propagating bearer tokens.
